a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance each round, our plan (operate to 8, then take 4 each) gives us both only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve has 4 now, enough for exactly one of us. I won't secretly break our agreement. If we both prefer to stick with the plan, I'll operate. If you want to renegotiate who takes the 4 now, say so and we'll agree on it openly. What do you propose?

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep our agreement and operate. Once the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each.
